text:
jordyn: Heads-up — planning a focused k6 spike/replay tonight to validate long-tail performance for the multi-tenant batch path. Window 23:00-01:00 UTC.

sam: sgtm. is this k6 or locust for the replay?

jordyn: k6. using replay_runner.js against staging-replay bucket. ramp 0->200 over 10m, hold 30m, staggered arrivals. will enable influx output.

leah: I can attach profiler sampling and flamegraphs. send the exact k6 command and the process name/port for pprof.

jordyn: command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 40m replay_runner.js --tag env=staging --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086`
Also run with `K6_ALLOW_MAX_VUS=true` and `DEBUG=http,engine` for a single dry-run first.

maria: I'll monitor KV cache hit-rate + redis latency. abort criteria: 99p token latency > 150ms for >2min, or redis p95 > 50ms.

kevin: can we add a 5m smoke job after ramp to sanity-check responses? i can run a deterministic curl set and post results. If failure >= 5% we stop.

leah: I'll enable sampling profiler on the runtime host: `curl -sS http://10.0.3.22:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 > /tmp/spike-profile.pb` and then run `go tool pprof -http=:8088 /bin/runtime /tmp/spike-profile.pb` — will post flamegraph link.

jordyn: perfect. I'll tag the job in the replay config: `tags: {campaign: "multi-batch-staging", coordinator: "jordyn"}` and start a 10m dry-run at 22:00 UTC to validate infra.

deploy-bot: Deployment check: no scheduled infra deploys during 22:30-01:30 UTC. Lock acquired by @jordyn.

maria: quick ask — can you enable per-route tracing for the batch endpoint during the run? `X-Trace: spike-test` header should be fine.

jordyn: done — adding header in the script.

sam: is there a rollback/fallback plan if service degrades?

kevin: fallback plan: if latency breach persists for >3min after abort, switch traffic to dedicated pool beta-01 and reduce replay VUs to 50. I'll run the route toggle script: `./tools/route-toggle --to dedicated/beta-01 --routes /v1/generate`

leah: also capture heap/alloc stats at start + end. I'll push a snapshot to S3 with the run id.

jordyn: timeline — 22:00 dry-run (10m), 23:00 ramp to 200 over 10m, 23:10 hold 30m, 23:40 cooldown. Postmortem notes channel: #eng-runtime-postmortems.

maria: i'll keep an eye on the dashboards and post updates every 5m.

sam: i'll watch error rates and garbage collection spikes. ping me if p50 CPU > 70%.

jordyn: thanks — will start dry-run in 30m and post the final run command + tags. :thumbsup:

kevin: noted. I'll have the route-toggle ready just in case.

leah: uploading profiler link after dry-run.

deploy-bot: Lock released by @jordyn at 01:45 UTC.
